title: rosidl-gen configuration
description: Configuration for rosidl-gen, which generates Go types from ROS 2 .msg/.srv definitions. Every path is resolved relative to this file.

out.description: Directory generated files are written to. Stale *.g.go files directly inside it are removed; nothing else is touched.

package.description: Go package name declared by every generated file.

search_paths.description: Directories scanned for ament packages: either a package itself (a directory holding package.xml) or a directory of them. The scan does not descend further than one level. Earlier entries win. ${VAR} is expanded, and an entry whose variable is unset is skipped.

generate.description: Interfaces to emit. Nested dependencies are pulled in automatically.

imports.description: Go import path for each qualifier used in `external`.

external.description: Interfaces bound to a Go type that already exists instead of being generated. A qualified value resolves through `imports`; an unqualified one must be hand-written in the output package. A .srv maps to the prefix of its Request/Response pair.

rename.description: Override the Go type name derived from an interface name. Needed only to break a collision.

as_error.description: Emit AsError() on a service response carrying `bool success` and `string message`. Default true.

names.description: Mirror a C++ topic/service name header into Go constants. Claimed by the built-in cppnames emitter.

out.description: Generated Go file, relative to this config rather than to `out`.

source.description: Path recorded in the generated `// source:` line. Defaults to `header` as written.

comment.description: Doc block rendered under the source line, one comment line per input line.
